dex.text: Sits motionless on the heath all day, looking like a bit of bark that has given up. Wakes at dusk to make a rattling trill and eat anything that flies past.
dex.fact: Nightjars spend the day sitting still on the ground, and they catch moths in flight after dark.

dex.text: Sits on the heath as bark by day and, once the light goes, gives the whole heath a low purr that you feel in your boots.
dex.fact: Nightjars are summer visitors that spend the winter in Africa, and arrive in Britain around May to nest on the ground.
